description: Fast orthogroup assignment of Drosophilid ABHD11-family proteins and conservation of the nucleophile loss
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def fas(acc): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
CG14717=fas('Q9VGJ4'); CG2059=fas('Q9W3R8'); HUM=fas('Q8NFV4')
def kmers(s,k=4): return Counter(s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1))
def cos(a,b):
    ks=set(a)|set(b); va=np.array([a[k] for k in ks],float); vb=np.array([b[k] for k in ks],float)
    return float(va@vb/(np.linalg.norm(va)*np.linalg.norm(vb)))
k14,k20=kmers(CG14717),kmers(CG2059)
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
  params=dict(query='(xref:panther-PTHR46118) AND (taxonomy_id:7214)',
              fields='accession,organism_name,length,sequence,gene_names',format='json',size=200),timeout=120)
res=r.json()['results']
pat=re.compile(r'G[HQNKRSAT](.)[MLIVFA]GG')
rows=[]
for e in res:
    s=e['sequence']['value']; org=e['organism']['scientificName']
    if not(200<=len(s)<=420): continue
    ks=kmers(s); s14,s20=cos(ks,k14),cos(ks,k20)
    best=None
    for m in pat.finditer(s):
        f=m.start()/len(s)
        if 0.28<f<0.62 and (best is None or abs(f-0.40)<abs(best[1]-0.40)): best=(m,f)
    gn=(e.get('genes') or [{}])[0]
    gname=gn.get('geneName',{}).get('value') or ((gn.get('orfNames') or [{}])[0].get('value') or '')
    rows.append(dict(acc=e['primaryAccession'],gene=gname,org=org.replace('Drosophila','D.'),length=len(s),
        elbow=best[0].group(0) if best else None,nuc=best[0].group(1) if best else None,
        pos=best[0].start()+3 if best else None,sim14=round(s14,3),sim20=round(s20,3),
        group='CG14717-like' if s14>s20 else 'CG2059-like'))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# collapse redundant D. melanogaster natural-variant entries
pd.set_option('display.width',220)
print("Drosophilid PTHR46118 proteins, 4-mer cosine similarity to each D. melanogaster paralog")
print(T.sort_values(['group','org','acc']).to_string(index=False))
print("\nElbow nucleophile x orthogroup:")
ct=pd.crosstab(T.group,T.nuc.fillna('not detected')); print(ct)
# unique species counts
for g,sub in T.groupby('group'):
    d=sub.dropna(subset=['nuc'])
    print(f"\n{g}: {d.org.nunique()} species, nucleophile residues: {dict(d.nuc.value_counts())}")
    print("   species with Ser:", sorted(set(d[d.nuc=='S'].org)))
    print("   species without Ser:", sorted(set(d[d.nuc!='S'].org)))
# sanity: references themselves
print("\nreference self-check:", T[T.acc.isin(['Q9VGJ4','Q9W3R8'])][['acc','gene','sim14','sim20','group','nuc']].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,5.4))
col={'S':'#2f855a','G':'#c53030','N':'#d69e2e','C':'#805ad5','A':'#dd6b20'}
for _,x in T.iterrows():
    if x.nuc is None: continue
    ax.scatter(x.sim20,x.sim14,s=80,color=col.get(x.nuc,'#999'),edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4,zorder=3)
lim=[min(T.sim14.min(),T.sim20.min())-.02,1.0]
ax.plot(lim,lim,'k--',lw=.8,zorder=1)
ax.set_xlim(lim);ax.set_ylim(lim)
ax.set_xlabel('similarity to CG2059 (4-mer cosine)');ax.set_ylabel('similarity to CG14717 (4-mer cosine)')
ax.set_title('Drosophilid ABHD11 family: two orthogroups, one of which lost the nucleophile\n'
             'green Ser, red Gly, yellow Asn, purple Cys, orange Ala',fontsize=10)
ax.annotate('CG14717 orthogroup',xy=(0.55,0.95),fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('CG2059 orthogroup',xy=(0.80,0.50),fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
